description: Non-material amendments to planning permission reference: 2022/00794/FUL dated 6th June 2022 for the "Erection of a new rear dormer to replace existing; alteration of existing window in the rear elevation at roof level from sash to casement; replacement rooflight to existing two storey rear outrigger; reclad existing rear elevation of the main roof; replacement of existing single glazed sash windows to front elevation with double glazed sash windows; erection of a single storey rear extension, to the side and rear of the existing back addition; erection of a glazed balustrade around part of the flat roof at first floor level of the proposed single storey rear extension, in connection with the enlargement of the existing roof terrace; installation of new sliding doors to replace existing doors to the rear elevation at first floor level, to provide access to the roof terrace."  Amendments sought are the installation of photo-voltaic panels to roof, adjustment to glazing fenestration to ground floor rear extension, and increase of terrace wall by 175mm.
borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
